name: simulation-official-docs
instructions: The official documentation of simulation standards and tools, kept locally: the Modelica language specification, the FMI and SSP standards, and the GNU Octave manual with the help of each Octave function (a language close to MATLAB). Search with search_docs, then read one section with read_doc. Look it up rather than guess it.
search: Search the official documentation of simulation: the Modelica language (classes, connectors, equations), the FMI standard (FMU, co-simulation, fmi3DoStep), the SSP standard, and GNU Octave (manual and functions, as ode45). Returns 10 section ids at most.
